## Objective
- Build a complete, playable bilingual Pokémon-inspired 2D MMORPG-style fangame based on the user’s French story about Professor Woars, Arceus, and Team Sky.

## Requirements
- Playable game with character selection or custom name entry.
- English and French language support.
- MMORPG-style elements and mobile-friendly controls.
- No clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained browser game using HTML, CSS, and Canvas, with original stylized creatures and scenery.

## Work State

### Completed
- Added title/character selection screen, bilingual toggle, custom player naming, rendered village, movement and interaction, dialogue/story progression, battle encounter, map, party/player panels, chat, and touch controls.
- Fixed a `drawCharacter` runtime reference error.
- Opened the app in Playwright and saved screenshots at `/tmp/opencode/game-start.jpg` and `/tmp/opencode/game-play.jpg`.

### Active
- Validate screenshot appearance and test gameplay interactions; the latest gameplay screenshot was saved but not inspected yet.
- Run a final JavaScript syntax check and inspect browser console after the runtime fix.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `/tmp/opencode/game-play.jpg` and check for console errors.
2. Test dialogue progression, movement, battle, map, and French language behavior; fix any issues.
3. Report completed work and note that online players/chat are simulated locally.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, HUD, title screen, dialogue, battle, map, and sidebar.
- `styles.css`: Desktop/mobile styling and touch interface.
- `game.js`: Canvas world rendering, movement, interactions, quests, battle, localization, and UI behavior.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Playwright browser is open at `http://localhost:3002`; browser screenshot path for the latest gameplay state is `/tmp/opencode/game-play.jpg`.
